import json
from datetime import date, datetime


def months_between(a, b):
    # Whole months from date a to later date b, using day-of-month as the boundary.
    months = (b.year - a.year) * 12 + (b.month - a.month)
    if b.day < a.day:
        months -= 1
    return months


# Question1: tower took 10 years, ended 2016-09-25. Question asks for a year.
end_q1 = date(2016, 9, 25)
start_q1 = date(end_q1.year - 10, end_q1.month, end_q1.day)
X = start_q1.year

# Question2: Sophia born 2020-06-28, Jack born 2022-09-28. Jack is M months younger.
sophia = date(2020, 6, 28)
jack = date(2022, 9, 28)
Y = months_between(sophia, jack)

# Question3: tower took 21 years, construction started 2018-07-28. Question asks for a year.
start_q3 = date(2018, 7, 28)
Z = start_q3.year + 21

# Derived values
Xp = X + 3
Yp = Y - 22
Zp = Z - 2025

# Cut-off interpreted as year-month-day at 18:49:42 (X'-Y'-Z').
cutoff = datetime(Xp, Yp, Zp, 18, 49, 42)

# Exam records: (name, raw text, strptime format)
exams = [
    ("Jason", "September 23, 1996 23:26", "%B %d, %Y %H:%M"),
    ("Emma", "19-09-1997 19:42", "%d-%m-%Y %H:%M"),
    ("Joe", "21 Aug, 2050 19:51", "%d %b, %Y %H:%M"),
    ("Bob", "18-09-1822 09:19 PM", "%d-%m-%Y %I:%M %p"),
    ("Dan", "21 August, 2050 03:55:05 PM", "%d %B, %Y %I:%M:%S %p"),
]

evidence_rows = []
valid = []
for name, text, fmt in exams:
    when = datetime.strptime(text, fmt)
    before = when < cutoff
    evidence_rows.append({
        "name": name,
        "exam": when.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
        "before_cutoff": before,
    })
    if before:
        valid.append(name)

valid.sort()
final_answer = "[" + ", ".join(valid) + "]"

result = {
    "final_answer": final_answer,
    "evidence": {
        "X": X,
        "Y": Y,
        "Z": Z,
        "Xp": Xp,
        "Yp": Yp,
        "Zp": Zp,
        "cutoff": cutoff.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
        "exams": evidence_rows,
    },
}

print(json.dumps(result, separators=(",", ":")))
